Registration binding (M478 C1 P1-H1/C2 #1 fix): a code activates only the row of its cookie; verify deletes the address's other pending rows in the same transaction; a later registration never changes an earlier row; the restart path moves only the matched row. Enumeration paths: register (same 202, cookie and hashing; account-exists email), password/forgot, code/resend and sign-in (pending and active alike: same 401 and a registration cookie) answer alike; only reset's 429 differs (F2). Sessions: sign-in revokes the old cookie's session and mints a new token; MFA verify mints a new token and revokes the pending one; registration verify makes a new session; idle 8 h with last_seen_at touched at most every 60 s in the resolve statement; absolute 24 h; cap 5 real and 3 pending under a per-user advisory lock; resolve requires an active user and sessions.owner_key = users.owner_key; reset revokes all, change revokes the others, sign-out-all revokes all.

CSRF and cookies: CSRF = HMAC(session secret, token) compared as ASCII bytes in constant time; Origin required on every write except the exact /api/v1/hooks/ prefix; no parameterised write route can match a hooks-prefixed path (route list); session and registration cookies HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure outside local (config.py:152-153).

TOTP and recovery: RFC 6238 SHA-1/30 s/6 digits, +/-1 step, last_step replay guard by an atomic conditional UPDATE; recovery codes HMAC-hashed, single use, only after confirmation; 100/10 consecutive caps with 24 h end and reset/operator ways out (N2 recorded). Mailer: claim by FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with a lease; Idempotency-Key = the row's key; backoff 5 s, 30 s, 2 min then failed; expired code emails marked expired at claim and again at delivery; payload nulled on sent (resend mode), failed, expired and suppressed; suppressed addresses never sent; log mode masks codes outside local and is refused outside dev/local with the switch on; the sender is its own task; no user text in any template and the address regex excludes whitespace and a second @ (no header injection).
